about.summary: Senior Laravel engineer who builds scalable web systems — SaaS platforms, APIs, desktop and mobile applications — with a focus on clean architecture, maintainability, and production reliability.
about.extended:
I am a Senior Software Engineer and Laravel Developer with 5+ years of professional experience designing and developing scalable web applications, SaaS platforms, REST APIs, and enterprise systems.

I work across diverse business domains depending on product needs — not limited to one industry. My experience includes education, events, logistics, retail POS, health apps, consultations, memberships, grants, and internal enterprise workflows.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to and led development across the full software lifecycle — from requirements analysis and system architecture to implementation, integration, debugging, optimization, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

I focus on building clean, maintainable, secure, and scalable systems rather than simply delivering functionality. I am particularly experienced in working with existing Laravel applications, understanding complex business logic, resolving difficult backend issues, modernizing legacy implementations, and extending systems with new features and integrations.

resume.profile: Senior Laravel Engineer with 5+ years of experience building SaaS platforms, REST APIs, enterprise systems, desktop (Tauri + React), and mobile (Expo) applications. Specialized in Laravel, Vue.js, multi-tenant architecture, and third-party integrations. Currently at TechTrans, Riyadh.
